description: This file defines an enumeration for different types of loan transaction relations within the Fineract project, including related constants, constructors, and a method to map integers to enum values.

classes.name: LoanTransactionRelationTypeEnum
classes.description: Enumeration for various loan transaction relation types, such as invalid, chargeback, charge adjustment, etc., with associated integer values and string codes.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the enum constant.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the code string associated with the enum constant.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Maps an integer to the corresponding enum value; returns INVALID if null or unrecognized.
